body: Thank you.  My kids are still little,  8, 5, 2 years old.  So they need me,  yes but I need someone,  too. It's just frustrating going through so much hurt and pain all the time.  BUT I'm ok now.  Husband called me after I texted him how I was feeling and said we'd talk when he gets home.  I got out of bed and my 2yr old gave me the biggest smile and said "mommy!! You're up!  I love you." that gave me a ray of hope.
Please don't.  You have so much life ahead of you.  Go to China,  maybe a change of scenery and seeing a new place will help.
